soundness_flags.label: def:certified-finite-profile and def:profiled-band
soundness_flags.one_line: Theta_cert is defined as retained rational boxes and certificates but is subsequently treated as a set of full laws Q in Theta subseteq Theta_cert and inf/sup_Q mu_Q; define its decoded outer union and interval endpoint evaluation before these claims are meaningful.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The compact-support blind repeated-measurement density problem has a matching squared-L2 lower rate (log log n/log n)^(2 beta), obtained by a Le Cam construction that perturbs the signal density.

source_verification_receipts.locator: article abstract and bibliographic record, pp. 474-496
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies and estimates the ADRF under treatment measurement error and derives asymptotic inference; the cited bibliography page range 1196-1216 is not the journal article's actual pagination.

The paper constructs a uniformly size-controlled confidence band for the density of a latent variable from repeated measurements by rewriting Kotlarski's identity as linear moment restrictions, without completeness.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Econometrics 207, 2018; arXiv corroborating version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The density-band method uses an auxiliary error sample, with a panel specialization relying on symmetric error information; it does not cover blind asymmetric replicate errors.
The paper establishes asymptotically valid uniform bands for an EIV regression function with unknown error using validation data or repeated measurements under its additional structure.
The paper develops minimum-distance deconvolution from panel data with unknown additive-error distribution and proves strong consistency under a zero-set condition.
The paper proves minimax sup-norm density-deconvolution lower bounds under a known convolution operator and gives attaining wavelet estimators.
The paper establishes finite-sample lower bounds on confidence-band width through testing arguments.
The paper develops nonparametric doubly robust estimation for the continuous-treatment dose-response curve under standard observational causal conditions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Business & Economic Statistics 44(1), 2026; accepted online 2025
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives doubly robust DML ADRF inference under unconfoundedness, with asymptotic theory pointwise and uniformly in treatment, but without treatment measurement error.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Colangelo and Lee's uniform error-free ADRF result to related work and state explicitly that the new obstacle is blind asymmetric replicate deconvolution rather than whole-curve causal inference itself.

Define a decode map from each retained rational box to a set of full laws, set Theta_cert to the union of those decoded sets, and define certified endpoint intervals so the containment and endpoint-inflation claims have a common type.

Specify one admissible fixed asymmetric error-law pair and a marked Bernoulli packet parametrization in the lower construction, including the intended chi-square/Hellinger bound, to make the fixed-nuisance converse independently auditable.

recommended_next_step: Revise the finite-certificate semantics and broaden the direct whole-curve ADRF survey, then resubmit this field-tier frontier for novelty review.
